question: Should Workspaces permanently expose the proposed state:persist capability and widget-state gateway and storage contract to approved custom widgets before the built-in notes editor lands?
rationale: This creates a durable plugin capability, sandbox-to-parent trust boundary, gateway API, and stored-data contract; implementation tests cannot choose that permanent product and security boundary or landing order.

options.title: Approve Contract First
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 first, then rebase this PR to the built-in notes consumer and focused fixes and proof.

options.title: Keep Notes Trusted-Only
options.body: Narrow persistence to a private built-in accessor and defer the custom-widget state:persist contract to separate design approval.

options.title: Pause Persistent Notes
options.body: Defer both changes until maintainers select another Workspaces persistence model.

recommendation.title: Approve Contract First
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 first, then rebase this PR to the built-in notes consumer and focused fixes and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline provides the strongest available maintainer-side routing signal for the active security-boundary review, while 100yenadmin owns the implementation history.
